description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL), with a linear scale, ranging from approximately 1 to 8, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, also on a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 32, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different model: Consistency-CE (purple, dashed, circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (maroon, dashed, square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue, dashed, square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red, solid, star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at approximately (1, 19) and ends at around (8, 31.5), showing a steady increase. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at about (1.5, 22.5) and ends at roughly (8, 31.5), also increasing steadily. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at approximately (1.5, 22.5) and ends at around (8, 31.8), with a similar upward trend. The Consistency-Bi line starts at about (1, 26) and ends at roughly (8, 32.2), maintaining the highest BLEU score across the range of Average Lagging values.
